The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e75bfb353c2d3374), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 57-58. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: After the choices of L and P0, take H sufficiently large. For every integer N ≥ 1 there is a microscopic coupling βN > 0 whose N regular transformations remain strictly inside the bands [Hj/2, 2Hj] and end at b0 = H. Every such choice satisfies βN = H + γN + OL,H(log(2 + N)). (6.5) 57 Along these trajectories, bj = ϑj + OL(1), 0 ≤ j ≤ N, (6.6) uniformly in N, with constants bounded as H is increased. The trajectories starting at the same βN with either inclined first step are also strictly admitted and satisfy Equation (6.6). Their terminal couplings agree with one another, although they need not equal H.
